title: The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition, V4.01
readingDepth: Table7 printed p138/PDF p28: pico and centi; Table8 printed p140/PDF p30: barn. Selected definitions, not whole brochure.
claim: Pico means 10^-12; centi means 10^-2; one barn is10^-28 square metres. Together these imply one picobarn is10^-36 square centimetres.
limits: This establishes a unit conversion only, not a reaction cross section, achieved energy output or the validity of a government program.
